decision.reference: Authorization bead bu-3lurlp for implementation bead bu-8ptawc (PR #4599, owner data export of the memory and all scopes reads each butler's own memory schema). Reviewed before: main d54670d49c90ed3e1990ecb53a84b2f6c327541f; approved subject: PR #4599 head 071afe3ed65156c815e1cc780936b2765e60c8c6 (review bu-ia51eo). This exact manifest requires its own independent review and protected-main publication before consumption; provenance text grants no runtime admission.

owners.reason: The memory scope now reads each butler's own memory schema through a real DatabaseManager roster, so archive members are named <butler>_memory_<table>.ndjson; the encrypted-zip, per-table content and fact/rule/episode field assertions are preserved.

The all scope's memory members are per-butler <butler>_memory_<table>.ndjson names built from the real roster; the full expected-member set, the non-memory tables and the encryption assertions are preserved.
The full alias still returns the same table set as all; its pool now sits behind a real DatabaseManager roster because the unqualified single-pool memory fallback is removed.
The embedding-column exclusion is still asserted on the memory facts member, now named <butler>_memory_facts.ndjson; retained and skipped columns are unchanged.

The plaintext-sentinel and encryption checks are unchanged for every scope; the pool is now registered in a real DatabaseManager roster so the memory and all scopes resolve their per-butler memory tables.

The real-Postgres export now goes through a DatabaseManager roster whose butler has the memory module and its own memory schema; the public-only search path, the three schema-qualified table reads and the stored-fact round trip are preserved, with archive members named <butler>_memory_<table>.ndjson.
